exercises.instruction: Прочитайте заметки и допишите предложения, используя слова из рамки. Где необходимо, вставьте The.

parts: is a country in northern Europe.
is a river in South America.
is the largest continent in the world.
is a country in East Africa.
is between Saudi Arabia and Africa.
is an island in the Caribbean.
are a group of islands near Florida.

exercises.instruction: Где необходимо, вставьте the. Напротив правильных предложений напишите OK.

items.prompt: Kevin lives in Newton Street.
We went to see an opera at Bolshoi Theatre.
Have you ever been to China?
Have you ever been to Philippines?
Have you ever been to south of France?
Can you tell me where Regal Cinema is?
Can you tell me where Bond Street is?
Can you tell me where Museum of Art is?
Europe is bigger than Australia.
Belgium is smaller than Netherlands.
answers: Belgium is smaller than the Netherlands.

items.prompt: Which river is longer – Mississippi or Nile?
answers: Which river is longer – the Mississippi or the Nile?

items.prompt: Did you go to Tretyakov Gallery when you were in Moscow?
We stayed at Park Hotel in Hudson Road.
answers: the Park Hotel in Hudson Road

items.prompt: How far is it from Trafalgar Square to Waterloo Station?
Rocky Mountains are in North America.
answers: The Rocky Mountains are in North America.

items.prompt: Texas is famous for oil and cowboys.
I hope to go to United States next year.
Mary comes from west of Ireland.
Alan is a student at Manchester University.
Panama Canal joins Atlantic Ocean and Pacific Ocean.
answers: The Panama Canal joins the Atlantic Ocean and the Pacific Ocean.

exercises.instruction: Переведите предложения на английский язык. (порт = port, курорт = resort)

items.prompt: Роттердам – это большой порт в Нидерландах.
answers: Rotterdam is a big port in the Netherlands.

items.prompt: Я хочу сходить в Большой Театр.
answers: I’d like to go to the Bolshoi Theatre.
I want to go to the Bolshoi Theatre.

items.prompt: Волга – самая длинная река в России?
answers: Is the Volga the longest river in Russia?

items.prompt: Сочи – это популярный курорт на Чёрном море.
answers: Sochi is a popular resort on the Black Sea.

items.prompt: Марк из Ричмонда. Это город на севере Англии.
answers: Mark is from Richmond. It’s a town in the north of England.

items.prompt: Гордон работает в гостинице Гранд в Лондоне.
answers: Gordon works in the Grand Hotel in London.
Gordon works at the Grand Hotel in London.

items.prompt: Вы хотите увидеть Лондонский Тауэр?
answers: Would you like to see the Tower of London?
Do you want to see the Tower of London?

items.prompt: Нина хочет жить в Соединённых Штатах и учиться в Гарварде.
answers: Nina wants to live in the United States and study at Harvard.
